name: report_statement
description: State the one thing a person must know or be able to do to answer the task well.

verdict.description: stated when you can say it; unsure when you cannot tell what answering well requires

statement.description: The one thing, in one short line. One demand only — never two joined by 'and'. Built only from what the task and answer contain: no examples, no parentheses, no code, no mention of the task or the passage. Required with stated.

reason.description: Why you cannot tell, in one sentence. Required with unsure.
